corpus: pilot-50 (Sayood/tanitad-ph0 :: ph0_pilot50/sam3/sam3.json) — G1's OWN 50 clips, a strict SUBSET of the 596-clip w120val leg (overlap 50/50, pilot-only 0). 292 `traffic sign` detections over 37 clips.
selection: G1's OWN rule, `G1_RESULT.md:6-7` — the LARGEST-AREA `traffic sign` detection per clip. CENSUS: all 37 clips that carry one.
evidence_class: MEASURED (human visual adjudication of rendered crops).
what_this_arm_is_for: ⭐ It holds the CORPUS and the SELECTION fixed at G1's own values and changes ONLY the rendering. Arm C re-read G1's actual tiles and reproduced G1's ~⅔-empty reading (48/54). If this arm — same clips, same rule, box OUTLINED in a context window — does not reproduce it, the difference is the RENDERING and not the detector, the corpus or the selection.
adjudication_basis: BOTH renderings of every detection were viewed before the verdict was fixed — G1's tight 4x LANCZOS from the 448-px bridge, and the study's 6x context window with the box outlined in gold. That is the practice `…/2026-08-16-sam3-concept-reliability/raw/g1_reconcile_verdicts.json` states verbatim.
blinding: the cells carried ONLY their index; score, clip, frame and box were withheld in `adjudication_sample_B_pilot50.json` and joined afterwards.

g1_subclass_1_empty_box.definition: `G1_RESULT.md:17` — `no sign visible in the crop at all: sky, foliage, building walls, clouds`. Scored separately from `wrong`, because a `wrong` cell holding a real salient object of another class is NOT what G1's ~two-thirds figure counted.
g1_subclass_1_empty_box.note: ⛔ ONE empty box in a 37-clip CENSUS under G1's own selection rule, on G1's own clips — against 48 of 54 on G1's own rendered tiles (arm C). The three other `wrong` calls all contain a real, salient object.

notes_on_the_wrong_calls.2007: ⭐ A GREEK PHARMACY SHOP SIGN — the tight 4x crop resolves `ΦΑΡΜΑΚΕΙΟ` down a vertical green fascia. Sign-shaped, sign-mounted, illuminated, and not traffic signage. ⚠️ Note the coincidence worth naming: `G1_SIGN_OCR_GRADING_SHEET.md` row 22 is `ΦΑΡΜΑΚΕΙΟ` on clip `15958430-1119` — the VLM read this same shop sign, and G1 correctly refused it as unverifiable. Same class as the reliability study's #207 (a pharmacy cross on a wall).
notes_on_the_wrong_calls.2023: a large black X over dark text on a green-illuminated office building at night — commercial building signage, not a level-crossing cross (which is white with red arms and stands at a rail crossing, not on a facade). ⚠️ Recorded as the less certain of the four calls.
notes_on_the_wrong_calls.2029: ⭐ A TRAFFIC LIGHT, not a sign: an orange directional arrow inside a dark oval signal housing. Genuine cross-class confusion INSIDE the traffic-infrastructure family — the study's #1001 in the opposite direction. This is the failure that matters for a KIND-blind consumer.
notes_on_the_wrong_calls.2034: EMPTY — a featureless dark horizontal band above the road at night. The only empty box in the arm.

borderline_calls_and_why.2002: a white disc bearing a single black diagonal stripe — the END-OF-RESTRICTION sign. `correct`. On the contact sheet it read as a stick or a branch; the tight 4x crop resolved it, and this is a case where G1's own rendering was the BETTER of the two (the study saw the same on its #1000).
borderline_calls_and_why.2019: a triangular warning sign only ~6 px across. Scored `correct` because the triangular outline with a lighter interior is unambiguous even at that size — not because it is legible.
borderline_calls_and_why.2016_2022_2031: black/yellow and red/white marker boards. `correct`: regulatory marker boards. Consistent with the study's #177 and with arm A's #7/#52.
borderline_calls_and_why.2008: an overhead gantry VMS panel showing coloured text. `correct`, consistent with the study's #165.
borderline_calls_and_why.2005: a large light slatted panel high on a mast. A louvre and the braced BACK of a large road sign look the same at this fidelity. `unclear`, deliberately not resolved in either direction.
borderline_calls_and_why.2004_2014_2021_2026: thin illuminated or pale boards carrying text at fidelity where street-name sign, commercial fascia and information board cannot be separated. `unclear`.
borderline_calls_and_why.2011_2030: a narrow vertical strip and a small dark rectangle with faint banding: structure present, class not resolvable. `unclear`.

the_measurement.note: point estimates only — the decision-grade interval is the episode-cluster bootstrap over clips, computed by the study's own `r8_g1_verdict_join.py`.
